BiblicalUsage: Hinnom is the valley south of Jerusalem that carries a Jebusite’s name. It is named 11 times in Scripture, in Joshua, 2 Kings and 2 Chronicles. The valley became the place of Tophet, and of the burning Jeremiah condemned — the place God said would be called the valley of slaughter.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hinnom matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that the valley’s name is worth knowing, because what happened there shows how far idolatry goes.
